name: rsocket-browser
description: The RSocket client implementation over websocket with browser compatibility based on Uint8Array
author: CKATEPTb

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vitest run test/async-queue.test.ts test/client.test.ts test/transport.test.ts test/java-rsocket.integration.test.ts test/spring-boot-rsocket.integration.test.ts
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/rewrite-dts-aliases.mjs && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
